name: Jiujiang Shanshui Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Jiujiang Shanshui Technology Co.,Ltd., established in 2012 and headquartered in Jiujiang, China, is a company dedicated to the innovation, manufacturing, and distribution of chemical intermediates. Its commercial activities primarily focus on the Chinese market, supplying crucial components for the production of dyes, agricultural products (pesticides), and pharmaceuticals. The company's extensive product catalog includes specialized compounds such as 6-nitro-1,2-diazooxynaphthalene-4-sulfonic acid, 1,2-diazooxynaphthalene-4-sulfonic acid, 5-nitro-2-aminophenol, 2-chloropyridine, and anthranilic acid. Other notable offerings comprise 4-nitro-2-aminophenol, O-aminophenol, 3-nitrophthalic acid, as well as distinct intermediates like 3-bromo-1-(3-chloro-2-pyridyl)-1H-pyrazole-5-carboxylic acid (referred to as pyrazole acid), 2-amino-5-chloro-3,N-dimethylbenzamide (known as K amine), and 2-chloro-5-aminophenol.
